input.quote: At the request of Harpoon, AbbVie shall permit an independent public accounting firm of nationally recognized standing designated by Harpoon and reasonably acceptable to AbbVie, [***], to audit the books and records maintained pursuant to this Section 6.11 ... Such examinations may not (a) be conducted for any [***] [***] (b) be conducted more than once in any [***] period ... Except as provided below, the cost of this audit shall be borne by Harpoon, unless the audit reveals a variance [***] from the reported amounts or [***], in which case AbbVie shall bear the cost of the audit.
input.rationale: Section 6.11 is the only audit right binding us (Section 3.8.5/p0332 runs in our favour against Harpoon and is not flagged). It is exercisable simply "at the request of Harpoon" with no advance notice period at all, which fails the fallback's 15-day notice element on a material term. The frequency limit and the cost-shifting threshold are both left open ([***]), so neither the once-per-year cap nor the 10% underpayment trigger is established on the face of the clause. We therefore target the fallback with three surgical edits inside Section 6.11: 15 days' prior written notice, a twelve-month frequency cap, and Harpoon bearing cost unless underpayment exceeds 10%. We have not pushed to the preferred position (30 days, off-site, no system access), and we note the auditor is already an independent nationally recognised accounting firm with disclosure limited to discrepancies.

mappings.element: Vendor may audit no more than once per year.
Vendor must give at least 15 days' notice of an audit.
Vendor bears audit costs unless underpayment exceeds 10 percent.

proposal.summary: Fix Section 6.11 audit terms: annual frequency, 15 days' prior written notice, Harpoon bears cost unless underpayment exceeds 10%.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 6.11 lets Harpoon call an audit on request with no notice period, and leaves the audit frequency and the cost-shifting threshold open. We have set the audit at no more than once in any twelve (12) month period, required fifteen (15) days' prior written notice, and confirmed Harpoon bears the audit cost unless the audit reveals an underpayment of more than ten percent (10%).

ops.oldText: be conducted more than once in any [***] period
